items.where: Table 'Match fruit trees to your climate', row 'Frost-free lowveld and coast', Notes cell (xh line 74)
items.english: Most deciduous fruit does not get enough winter cold here. Choose low-chill varieties.
items.draft: Uninzi lweziqhamo zemithi ephulukana namagqabi alufumani bandla lanele ebusika apha.
items.backtranslation: Most fruit of leaf-losing trees does not get enough 'bandla' (read as ibandla = congregation/church) in winter here.
items.problem: 'bandla' is not the word for cold (ibanda); as written it reads as 'congregation', so the reason low-chill varieties are needed is lost. Row 4 of the same table and the glossary use 'ibanda'.
items.corrected: Uninzi lweziqhamo zemithi ephulukana namagqabi alufumani banda lanele ebusika apha.
